facts.fact: The FY2026/27 finance law of 30 June 2026 appropriates RWF 116,184,997, all recurrent and domestically financed, to sub-programme B901 Civil Registration under programme B9 National Identification of institution 28 MINICT, out of RWF 2,287,611,846 for the programme; the line names the function and no system.

systems.system: National ID System (sub-programmes B902 and B903)
systems.country_label: Identity Card Production and Distribution; National ID System Infrastructure and Security
systems.tiers: RWF 1,245,513,610 and RWF 925,913,239 appropriated for FY2026/27

note: The one fact is a budget line for the civil registration function, not for a described system; the parent may prefer to drop it.
